content.title: Koyo 6301-2RS Rubber Sealed Ball Bearing, 12mm Bore x 37mm OD x 12mm Width
content.short_description: Koyo 6301-2RS single-row deep groove ball bearing with double rubber (2RS) seals. Bore 12 mm, OD 37 mm, width 12 mm.
content.long_description:
The Koyo 6301-2RS is a single-row deep groove ball bearing sized to 12 mm bore, 37 mm outer diameter, and 12 mm width, matching the standard 6301 series envelope. It is fitted with 2RS rubber seals on both sides of the bearing, which contact the inner race to restrict entry of dust, moisture, and debris while retaining internal lubricant.

This bore/OD/width combination is used in general power transmission and rotating equipment applications where a compact deep groove bearing is required. The 2RS seal configuration is intended for environments where contamination control is a factor, as compared to open or single-shielded variants.

Confirm shaft and housing fit against the listed 12 mm bore and 37 mm OD dimensions before ordering, and verify the 12 mm width matches the axial space available in the application.
